head: bcaf7a2538a10176c89dd1fddddafbe29826b56e
scope: Read-only existing zenpower hwmon support: CPU SVI2 Core voltage and temperatures through collector/cache/source selection/IPC/LCD preview. Synthetic filesystem roots and MockBackend only. No host sysfs polling, module install/load, k10temp changes, raw SMN, actual HID, production daemon or native GUI.
implementation: Accept only hwmon name zenpower and in1_input with exact SVI2_Core/cpu0 SVI2_Core/cpu1 SVI2_Core labels. Both inspected repositories register this hwmon name. in0/SoC/VID/unknown or missing labels and unqualified driver aliases are excluded.
Driver-reported mV ->Volts once, existing bounded scalar/enable/invalid/zero/cache freshness semantics retained. ID hwmon:<physical>:zenpower:in1 survives hwmon renumbering.

Known zenpower temperature channels use Celsius and existing CpuTemperature role. CPU voltage uses existing CpuVoltage/source defaults; physical identity and preserved source labels remain data. No extra polling loop, default migration or implicit binding retarget.
Existing realtime LCD sensor layer receives cache values; Fahrenheit settings do not convert voltage. Missing/stale revokes usable value and fresh sample recovers the same theme.

checks.expanded_existing_ipc_lcd_preview_test: passed for zenpower as well as previous WMI/other providers
checks.native_gui: not run; no frontend/native application source change

coverage: Exact rail/labels, core vs SoC/VID rejection, CPU temperature/voltage roles and explicit/recommended selection.
Physical ID through hwmon renumber, input disappearance/return, preserved old binding vs refused new missing binding.
Wrong/missing label, unsupported driver alias, disabled/malformed/negative input and invalid enable. Actual zero remains valid zero; stale clears value.
Synthetic hwmon ->collector ->cache ->real IPC ->LCD JPEG:900mV formats0.90V, stale renders unavailable with different JPEG, recovered sample restores exact fresh JPEG without editing theme.
limits: No claim of all AMD CPU/kernel/zenpower fork support, native source-picker acceptance or analog measurement accuracy.
No automatic module installation/loading or disabling other drivers. Underlying driver-reported SVI2 voltage is not substitute for calibration/Windows reading comparison.
Other CPU voltage and proprietary NVIDIA outside X platform coverage remain open.
Windows-equivalent Intel aggregate remains unproven; no sum/max/mean engine estimate introduced.
Physical cadence/latency/sleep/accuracy and combined realtime LCD acceptance remain deferred.
